rows.Bloom: Deep pink. Mild fragrance. up to 45 petals. Medium, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long buds.
rows.Habit:
Bushy. Medium, matte, medium green foliage.

Height: 28" to 32" (70 to 80cm). Width: up to 16" (up to 40cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: French artist Gustave Courbet was born 10 June 1819 and died 31 December 1877.
